mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.koscom_cd AS koscomCd , t1.close AS close , t1.volume AS volume , t1.value AS value , t1.preclose AS preclose , t1.change AS change , t1.aekm AS aekm , t1.sangj_jusu AS sangjJusu , t1.mod_dt AS modDt , TO_CHAR(t1.mod_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS modDtStr , F_KOSCOM_NM(t1.corp_gr, t1.koscom_cd) AS xxKoscomCd FROM SJT0TG t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY t1.koscom_cd ASC

SELECT DISTINCT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.koscom_cd AS koscomCd , F_KOSCOM_NM(t1.corp_gr, t1.koscom_cd) AS xxKoscomCd , NVL(tg.close, 0) AS preclose , NVL(tg.close, 0) AS close , 0 AS change , 0 AS volume , 0 AS value , 0 AS aekm , 0 AS sangjJusu FROM SJM0JM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SJT0TG tg ON tg.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND tg.ymd = F_OPEN_YMD(t1.ymd, '-1') AND tg.koscom_cd = t1.koscom_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SJT0TG sub WHERE sub.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND sub.ymd = t1.ymd AND sub.koscom_cd = t1.koscom_cd ) ORDER BY t1.koscom_cd ASC
